findings.current: Jeok Cheongang’s fist was lava and lightning at once.
findings.defect: The Korean compares the fist to lava and a flash of light (섬광), not lightning. “Lightning” adds an electrical phenomenon the source does not establish.
findings.rationale: 섬광 means a flash or streak of light; it does not mean lightning.
findings.replacement: Jeok Cheongang’s fist was lava and a flash of light at once.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with one added physical detail in the description of Jeok Cheongang’s fist.
